[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction. Bidding your true private value ($24) is a dominant strategy: you win whenever the highest competing bid is below $24 and pay the second-highest bid, never overpaying. Bidding higher risks winning at a price above your value; bidding lower risks losing profitable wins. Therefore bid $24.]
